question: Can observable causal conditions make a joint-load tolerance more selective than the rejected shared force-scaled rule?
authorization_scope: Existing-log condition diagnosis first. A predeclared tiny adaptive schedule is tested offline only if the primary necessary-condition audit does not exclude its class. Live LQR/observer/feedforward/preparation unchanged. No runtime/controller implementation.
prior_inspection: All three I58/I60-I62 episodes and previous errors were already inspected. All fitting/folds on these episodes are retrospective internal assessment, not unseen validation.
original_campaign: I-58 native gain-scheduled LQR Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight; initial common shaft -1.0,+0.3,+0.9 rad, yaw 45 deg, command caps [1.5,0.6,0.6 N m,0.3,0.3 m/s]. Existing exact 5 ms state and prior applied input used by I-60/I-61.
information_boundary: Inference features use exact simulated body/joint state, raw observer intrinsic normal, observer filtered/last-interval generalized loads, known patch geometry and past timestamps. No solver contacts, true slip, true load shares/counts, terrain, native support identity, proposed candidate identity, eventual future winner, or future-frame filtering.
feature_diagnostics: L2 joint/force/moment innovations normalized by R*norm(F) or norm(F)
four axial seam offsets/distances and past approach rates
four spherical surface arclength offsets and past rates
motion diagnostics from saved qdot if exported, not primary-rule inputs

primary_risk.force_valid: Finite observed norm(F)>=1N; same-time interval_mean and filtered vector, all nine finite. These are inferred loads; interval ends at current logged state, not a computation-delay measurement.
primary_risk.geometry: Normalize raw intrinsic normal; for each known patch k use signed unit body x axis and offset -R*n to compute z_k. Polar seam coordinate is shell upper or belt lower, never the equatorial rim/gap boundary.
primary_risk.h: R*(acos(clip(z_k/R,-1,1))-acos(polar_seam_k/R)), signed surface arclength; positive equatorial side, negative polar side.
primary_risk.hdot: Backward difference separately for each signed arclength h_k, using only immediately preceding adjacent 5ms (+/-1e-9s) state with valid geometry. First/missing predecessor invalid. Do not differentiate nearest distance or use centered differences.
primary_risk.r: max(u,s); valid only observer signal and all current/preceding seam geometry/rates valid. Unknown stays NaN plus validity flag.
primary_risk.scales: Fixed engineering scales from I61 normalization and existing 12mm/120ms preparation. Not fitted noise statistics or calibrated probabilities. Arccos clipping is numerical protection; rate is a causal diagnostic, not predicted touchdown.
primary_risk.correlation: u and s share observer information and are not independent sensors. Raw normal motion contributes to seam rate.
primary_risk.pre_execution_correction: Before any source/input freeze or historical feature arithmetic, replace proposed axial primary seam distance/rate by spherical arclength. Known polar cap has only about4.35mm axial depth, so a12mm axial scale would flag the entire cap. Retain unexecuted earlier advice/source as superseded, without numeric outcome selection.

primary_mask: 1 <= time_s < 41, total truth normal load >=1 N, unique dominant family >=90% total load; fixed I-61 eligible mask. Dominant support is not strict single contact.
point_mask: Primary mask AND finite N point, finite A point (accepted proposal else N), and finite truth equivalent point. Fixed for every parameter and policy; never restrict distance metrics to retained proposals. Unaccepted raw proposals do not exclude a valid native fallback. Distances in mm to truth equivalent point.

policies.A: I-60 accepted proposal else native; no additional veto
policies.I61: a=0.03,b=0.10; must reproduce I-61 C policy flags and primary metrics

diagnostic_groups.harmful: Native family correct and A wrong (known6 frames)
diagnostic_groups.useful: Native wrong and A correct (known294 frames)
diagnostic_groups.accepted_wrong: A uses accepted proposal and family wrong (known18 frames)
diagnostic_groups.point_extremes: Every primary A point above corresponding native pooled maximum; also per-phase maxima and label-neutral point changes
diagnostic_groups.old_forced: All99 pooled exact-sign useful witnesses from I62, matched by case/time and also asserted against reconstructed pooled static bound. Per-phase summaries slice this pooled99 mask; optional per-phase-native-max bounds have distinct labels.

events: Report phase-wise frames and contiguous event clusters (same case and predicate, neighboring full-rate rows exactly5ms within1e-9). Do not call six frames six independent events. Event figures use fixed +/-0.10s windows around every harmful cluster, each phase worst A point, and the first/largest u/s useful correction; later frames shown only as explanatory plotting context, never as inference input.
descriptive_statistics: Complete per-event/frame feature table, per-phase valid/unknown counts, quantiles and overlap of u/s/r/raw innovations/geometry for all groups; no p-value/generalization claim. No fitted risk-only cutoff, no posthoc choice between u-only/s-only/r.

primary_necessary_condition.class: tau_i=a+(b*R_i)*norm(F_i)+c*r_i with a,b,c>=0 (real affine class on fixed inputs)
primary_necessary_condition.unsafe: A accepted point error exceeds native pooled max+1e-12mm on fixed common finite point mask. Every such proposal must be rejected to satisfy point maximum gate.
primary_necessary_condition.forced_loss: For a valid useful proposal i and valid unsafe proposal k, reject k implies reject i if m_i>=m_k AND m_i*L_k>=m_k*L_i AND m_i*r_k>=m_k*r_i, where m=maxabs extra-joint residual, L=R*norm(F). Union rows once; verify strict margins/exact signs for any impossibility conclusion.
primary_necessary_condition.unknown_risk: Positive-c schedules retain A at unknown-risk frames, so unknown useful frames are not forced losses; an unknown-risk unsafe peak cannot be rejected by positive-c schedules. c=0 remains original gate regardless of risk, already excluded by I62 continuous bound.
primary_necessary_condition.stop: If full-data forced useful losses>total A harmful opportunities (6), or a positive-c unsafe peak is unrejectable, the combined-risk class cannot meet both pooled errors<=A and pointmax<=N. Stop adaptive fitting and new-episode work; report score-specific limitation, not impossibility for all dynamic rules.

conditional_schedule.only_if: Primary combined-risk necessary-condition audit does not exclude the class; absence of a bound is inconclusive, not acceptance.
conditional_schedule.unknown_risk: For c>0 disable extra veto and retain A. For c=0 evaluate original force-scaled gate, not NaN*0. Never drop unknown rows from policy/error/point metrics.
conditional_schedule.folds: Three leave-one-start-out folds. Fit on two entire starting-phase episodes, evaluate the third. No random 5 ms sample splits.
conditional_schedule.no_feasible: Failed selection, off/A diagnostic fallback; no nearest miss promoted.
conditional_schedule.OOF: Every fold must have a qualified training fit. Concatenated held-out predictions must pass the same pooled gates plus each-phase error/harm gates. Relative harm reduction is unscorable when a phase has no A harmful examples; retain that flag and use nonincrease for that phase. Pooled opportunities are nonzero.
conditional_schedule.full_data: One fitted full-data (a,b,c), descriptive retrospective only, no per-phase rule. Components never replace frozen combined risk after inspection.

fresh_episode_condition.only_if: All three training folds qualified AND pooled OOF all gates pass AND full-data fit qualified; otherwise no new physics.
fresh_episode_condition.case: New native-controller Mars figure-eight, shaft+0.6rad,yaw45deg,44s,same caps/model. Seal episode source/settings and fixed full-data adaptive candidate before run. New native state/observer logs evaluated offline; adaptive policy does not actuate.
fresh_episode_condition.gates: Apply unchanged I62 harm/useful/error/point gates to new fixed candidate vsA, report zero-opportunity relative metrics unscorable. New episode cannot trigger retuning.
fresh_episode_condition.limitation: Fresh contact-estimation evaluation, not proof of improved physical tracking or live adoption.

replay: Archive source/input SHA256 before new arithmetic. Preserve primitives for NumPy-only condition replay, all masks/metrics and independently checked exact-sign bounds. Kinematic axes regeneration requires original model; explicitly cached. Preserve setup failures/corrections without overwriting. No overlapping test counts.

training_gates.pooled_family_errors_max: A errors on identical training states
training_gates.each_phase_harmful_count_max: A harmful count on same phase

independent_numeric_validation.reason: Independent scalar dot products and producer einsum may round differently; arccos near poles and backward differentiation amplify last-bit errors. These are verification allowances only, not scientific tolerance or value replacement. Report every actual difference.
independent_numeric_validation.masks_counts_decisions: Must match exactly; independently report robust forced losses with risk margin >=(m_i+m_k)*1e-4 to assess entire registered perturbation envelope.
